 Kick viewers can win one of 10,000 free GTA 6 Ultimate Edition copies by watching 3 hours
 Kick is giving away 10,000 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition codes for PS5 and Xbox, and watching any stream for three hours unlocks a case with a chance to win one.
 VIEW GALLERY - 3 Grand Theft Auto 6 artwork accompanies Kick's giveaway, which offers viewers a chance at one of 10,000 Ultimate Edition codes after watching three hours of streams. Jak Connor Tech and Science Editor Published Nov 12, 2026 9:13 AM CST 1 minute & 15 seconds read time What you need to know
 Kick is offering 10,000 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition codes for PS5 and Xbox through the Sunset Reward Case promotion. Watching any stream for three hours unlocks a case, which may contain cosmetics or a code; winning is not guaranteed. Entries are open through December 7.

Streaming platform Kick is giving away 10,000 digital copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 Ultimate Edition ahead of the game's November 19 launch, and all viewers have to do for a chance at one is watch any stream on the platform for three hours.
 Go ad-free with Supporter See plans and prices 
 The promotion is called the Sunset Reward Case, and Kick Support explains on X that viewers unlock a case by watching any stream for three hours, then tap the case beside their avatar to open it.
 Read more : Rockstar brings Vice City to life with GTA 6: The Festival in Miami 
 Kick's official rules state the case can contain emotes, badges, or a GTA 6 code for PS5 or Xbox Series X|S, with entries open until December 7. Viewers can unlock a new case every day to build a streak, and new users also get a free case after finishing account setup.
 3 The GTA 6 Ultimate Edition pictured here is the top prize in Kick’s Sunset Reward Case promotion, but watching three hours only earns viewers a chance to win a code. VIEW GALLERY - 3 IMAGES So, is it actually a free copy of GTA 6? Not for everyone, as Kick's rules say each valid case entry has the same chance of containing a GTA 6 code, and " winning is not guaranteed. "
 Kick doesn't publish the odds, but with GTA 6's Ultimate Edition selling for $100, the full prize pool is worth around $1 million at retail. Kick contacts provisional winners by email to verify eligibility, and codes won't be issued before November 19, so winners won't be able to preload the game through the promotion.
 3 Grand Theft Auto 6 artwork accompanies Kick’s giveaway, which offers viewers a chance at one of 10,000 game codes after watching a stream for three hours. Notably, Xbox codes are open to eligible entrants worldwide, while PS5 codes only work for PlayStation Network accounts registered in a list of supported countries, which includes the US, UK, Canada, and Japan.
 Story Q&A
 Powered by TweakBot
 From TweakTown's coverage of this story.
 Can Kick viewers combine watch time across different streams or sessions to unlock the Sunset Reward Case?
 Kick says watching any stream for three hours unlocks a Sunset Reward Case. It does not specify whether watch time across different streams or separate sessions can be combined, so that cannot be confirmed. How do daily Sunset Reward Case resets and streaks work on Kick?
 Watch any Kick stream for three hours to unlock a Sunset Reward Case, then tap the case beside your avatar to open it. You can unlock a new case each day to build a streak, but the rules cited here do not specify when the day resets or what happens if you miss one. Each valid case entry has the same chance of containing a GTA 6 code, so a streak is not stated to improve your odds. What eligibility requirements must entrants meet to claim a GTA 6 Ultimate Edition code through Kick?
 To enter, viewers can watch any Kick stream for three hours to unlock a Sunset Reward Case, then open it beside their avatar. New users also receive a free case after completing account setup, and entries are open until December 7. If a case contains a GTA 6 Ultimate Edition code, Kick emails the provisional winner to verify eligibility; Xbox codes are open to eligible entrants worldwide, while PS5 codes require a PlayStation Network account registered in a supported country, including the US, UK, Canada, or Japan. No purchase or subscription is required, and opening a case does not guarantee a code. Which countries can redeem the PS5 GTA 6 code, and how does PlayStation Network region affect eligibility?
 The PS5 GTA 6 code works only with PlayStation Network accounts registered in Kick's supported countries, which include the US, UK, Canada, and Japan. The full country list is not given here, so a viewer's location alone does not establish whether their PSN account can redeem a code. Got another question? Ask TweakBot.
